overview: Anxiety disorders are the world’s most common mental disorders, affecting people with fear and worry that is both intense and excessive, accompanied by physical tension and other behavioural and cognitive symptoms. These feelings are typically difficult to control, cause significant distress and can last a long time if untreated. Anxiety disorders interfere with daily activities and can impair a person’s family, social and school or working life.
symptoms: excessive fear or worry about a specific situation
excessive fear or worry about a broad range of everyday situations
having a sense of impending danger, panic or doom
diagnosis: talk therapy with professionals or supervised lay therapists
prevention: school-based programmes to enhance social and emotional learning
building positive coping in children and adolescents
key_facts: More women are affected by anxiety disorders than men
Symptoms of anxiety often have onset during childhood or adolescence
